llm.evidence: Eluting peptides were ionized at a potential of +2 kVa into a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher, Bremen, Germany).
we used in-depth proteomics based on label-free nanoLC-MS/MS of gel-fractionated proteins to generate proteomic profiles of a cohort of 20 patients.

The top 10 peptide signals (charge-states 2+ and higher) were submitted to MS/MS in the HCD (higher-energy collision) cell (1.6 amu isolation width, 25% normalized collision energy).
